title: Web novel covers
intro: Covers for a collection of original web novels, from a lonely lighthouse to an archaeological dig in Laos. Each one hints at the story without giving it away.
brief: Six very different stories, each needing a cover that sets its genre and mood at a glance, without revealing what happens inside.
did: Every cover as its own piece, built around a single nod to the story's subject: enough to draw a reader in, never enough to spoil the plot.

images.title: Ultramarine Blue
images.text: A priest in a small Irish town questions his calling, and the way out of the clergy. Ongoing since 2025.

images.title: 11 Degrees
images.text: A mystery that unfolds when the archive of a 400-year-old estate floods just as it goes up for sale, and a paper conservator is called in to salvage it.

images.title: Raking Light
images.text: Racing the end of the season, a crew on a dig in Laos uncovers what could be ancient writing.

images.title: Magpie's Tail
images.text: A spy thriller about a network smuggling documents through small bookshops.

images.title: 7 Seconds
images.text: A short story: solitude on one of the last manned lighthouses on the Irish coast, interrupted by a shipwreck.

images.title: Unlikely Roommates
images.text: Slice of life: two people forced to share a home after a flat floods.
